svg.title: The final mixed-row configuration for an unequal L
svg.desc: Four alternating long boundary legs and a mixed pair above them. The example uses a=6,b=4. The uncovered cell (2,2) begins the finite obstruction.
svg.text: The mixed row forced when a = b + 2
Example: P(6,4,0,0). Dots mark junctions. The red cell is (2,2).
The contradiction requires the exhaustive continuation proof; the picture alone is a legal partial packing.
